newsitem.title: USA: Merry Land chairman/CEO Peter Knox III dies.
newsitem.headline: Merry Land chairman/CEO Peter Knox III dies.

text.p: Merry Land & Investment Co Inc said on Monday that Peter S. Knox III, chairman and chief executive officer of the company, died following a battle with cancer.
Knox served as Merry Land's chairman and chief executive officer since it was spun-off from Merry Companies Inc in 1981.
In the fall, a number of interim appointments were made by the company in view of his illness. The appointments have now been made permanent.
W. Tennent Houston, president has been named as chief executive officer.

Boone Knox, the brother of the late Peter Knox III, becomes chairman of the board. Boone Knox serves as chairman of the board and chief executive officer of Allied Bankshares Inc, a bank holding company based in Thomson, Georgia, and director of Cousins Properties Inc, an Atlanta-based office and retail REIT.
Michael Thompson would serve as chief operating officer. Thompson has been vice president of acquisitions and development for Merry Land.
